339-677-4885-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-4885-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

225-619-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-619-2645-3430.description:
Activate Dormant Volcano by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Dormant Volcano
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

206-4770-5301-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3490-3755-7075-8201.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3755-7075-8201.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1231-4826-6644-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

728-1981-2324-2415.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Proper Burial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4050-4182-4668-7639.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least five cards this turn.
4050-4182-4668-7639.description:
Cast Whispers of the Muse by paying {U} due to Heliod
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whispers of the Muse.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7510.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hancock enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2511-6972-7510.notes: If Hancock starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

2556-4872-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3617-7443.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or more lands.
3617-7443.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance.
3617-7443.description:
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing it to become prepared.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
3617-7443.notes: If Emeritus of Abundance is prepared when starting the combo, you can forego attacking with it and skip straight to step 2 the first iteration. This also removes the necessity of Emeritus not have summoning sickness.

206-2366-3430-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
206-2366-3430-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2933-4499-4742-5798.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7233.easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value 2 or greater.
6798-6972-7233.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Inferno Project.
When Inferno Project dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

465-2150-4050.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Repeat from step 3.

630-955-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
630-955-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

4008-4297-7053.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a card in their graveyard that they cannot have multiple copies of in their deck.
4008-4297-7053.description:
Activate Junktroller by tapping it, putting any card an opponent has in their graveyard that they cannot have multiples copies of in their deck onto the battom of their library.
Cast Tunnel Vision by paying {5}{U}, naming the card that was put into the bottom of the opponent's library. This will cause the opponent to mill their entire library until they reveal that card and put it on top of their library.
Cast Archmage's Charm by paying {U}{U}{U}, causing the opponent to draw two cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control without summoning sickness

2815-3259-5549.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional creature that does not have summoning sickness, or you control a Treasure.
2815-3259-5549.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2815-3259-5549.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Vihaan triggers, causing Treasures you control to become 3/3 Construct Assassin creatures in addition to their other types.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Professional Face-Breaker's first ability.
Resolve the Professional Face-Breaker trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature with Breath of Fury attached, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature, untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2815-3259-5549.notes: You should attach Breath of Fury to a Treasure when possible. On the first iteration, if you didn't control a Treasure upon starting the combo, you can attach Breath of Fury to another creature without summoning sickness. For every other iteration, attach Breath of Fury to the Treasure made previously.

3129-5636-5742-5743.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

630-4826-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
630-4826-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
630-4826-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Archelos.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

2249-4186-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2249-4186-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Death's Presece triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

513-1031-2104.description:
Cast Invasion of Arcavios by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning up to one nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand, or searching your library for Temporal Manipulation and putting it into your hand, if needed.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Invasion of Arcavios to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-3000-5320.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
2034-3000-5320.description:
Use Ashnod's Altar to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Chatterfang.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
2034-3000-5320.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Ashnod's Altar, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

413-1069-1778-5222.description:
Cast Memnite.
Untap Blasting Station.
Equip Sword of the Realms to Memnite for {0}.
Activate Blasting Station, sacrificing Memnite deal 1 damage to any target.
Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Memnite to your hand.
Repeat.

480-1349-5256.description:
Move to your end step.
Athreos triggers, placing a coin counter on Skullbriar.
Sacrifice Skullbriar to Altar of Dementia to mill target player 1.
Athreos triggers, returning Skullbriar to the battlefield.
Repeat.
